dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to buy a weapon?

dialogues.speaker: Dwarkanath
dialogues.text: I'm fine myself, I already have a handy one. It's just that my brother Iradj is always going on about how he wants a Claymore and he asked me to keep an eye out for one.

dialogues.speaker: Dwarkanath
dialogues.text: Strange, just where can I buy a sword that's not only fit for purpose, but also looks nice? I asked him why he wants it, but he just hemmed and hawed without giving me a clear answer...

dialogues.speaker: Dwarkanath
dialogues.text: Ah! Maybe he wants to buy it as a gift for a girl somewhere? But... which girl would want a greatsword as a gift?
